integrity: Proof and independent finite literal-source and rational-arithmetic checks provided. The finite checks do not replace the all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed marker count, only conditional zero deletions, ordinary linear outputs; potential prior equivalent in Dirichlet-mixed coupon collection. Exact finite expectations and asymptotics proved, no independent verification.
title: Logarithmic zero-deletion trace coverage and a heavy-tailed Dirichlet limit
